text_block_list.name: Letter from a Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Buena Vista, Your last race was 
truly incredible."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Right here! Hyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista! It's Buena Vista! A 
magnificent late charge from the back, and 
she crosses the fiiinish line in first!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Even though she was so far back... 
Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Back then, nothing seemed to go right. I 
couldn't find the motivation to do 
anything. But..."

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Girl
text_block_list.text:
"An exhibition race I just happened to 
watch. Chasing from behind, and winning in 
the end. That Buena-san was..."

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Girl
text_block_list.text: “It was truly, truly sparkling.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You... were watching today's race, weren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: B-Buena-san!? Why are you……!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I knew it! Our eyes met for a second 
back there, didn't they? Thank you for 
cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much! Your run just now 
was truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"So... there's something I wanted to ask— 
how can you keep running without giving 
up?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up... Are you talking about how 
she ran just now?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Buena-san was way in the back the 
whole time. Surrounded by so many girls, 
and so far from the lead. ...If it were 
me, I definitely would have given up.

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Don't you ever feel anxious... thinking, 
'What if I don't make it in time?'

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Anxious, huh...

text_block_list.name: Buena from "That Day"
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. One day, we definitely will 
too—!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, you're right. There are times I 
feel anxious, times I feel like giving up, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
There is someone who has always supported 
me. And it's because I believe in that 
person—in my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Girl
text_block_list.text:
"I believe in my Trainer." Seeing Buena 
declare that with such unwavering 
conviction—

text_block_list.name: Letter from a Girl
text_block_list.text:
“—I wanted to become someone like that 
too. Someone who can support those chasing 
their dreams.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Among the many letters that arrived for 
Buena Vista, there was one penned by a 
young girl who had watched her race.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"—'If I pass the Trainer Academy exam, 
I'll send another letter. I'll always be 
cheering you on.' ...*sniff*."
choice_data_list:
Looks like she's found something to aim 
for too, huh.

Looks like she's found something to aim 
for too, hasn't she.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Maybe it was Buena's running that gave me 
a dream.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, yeah! If that's true... that'd 
make me so happy.
